sentences.japanese: 金の延べ棒１本を盗まれた。
sentences.english: We had a bar of gold stolen.

sentences.japanese: 学校に本や紙や鉛筆がないのを知ると、彼女は棒きれで地面にアルファベットを書いた。
sentences.english: When the school had no books or paper or pencils, she wrote the alphabet on the ground with a stick.

sentences.japanese: ものさしでその棒の長さを測りなさい。
sentences.english: Measure the length of the stick with a ruler.

sentences.japanese: マッチ棒の頭にそれらは５個のせることができるくらいです。
sentences.english: You can put five of them across the head of a match.

sentences.japanese: ぶつかられた後でもその棒はまだまっすぐに立っていた。
sentences.english: Even after it was hit, the pole was still upright.
